maya: quick heads up — conversion for hf/galatea-small hit a weird regression in the quant evals. responses have an extra special token in the middle (looks like token bleed).

ev an: logs? sample output?

maya: paste: 
```
input: "Describe the solar system"
output: "The solar system is <|user|> composed of eight planets..."
```

ev an: hmm that's a classic special-token mapping issue. did the tokenizer keep HF special tokens or did conversion remap them?

ben: also check config.json fields — we saw rope_scaling + sliding_window differences cause KV cache offsets on some models. can you drop the config?

maya: current converted config snippet: 
```
{"rope_scaling": 0.9, "sliding_window": false, "num_key_value_heads": 32, "max_position_embeddings": 2048}
```
original HF config: 
```
{"rope_scaling": 1.0, "sliding_window": true, "num_key_value_heads": 16, "max_position_embeddings": 4096}
```

carla: oh wow — num_kv_heads mismatch + sliding_window flipped = likely off-by-one in KV indexing during streaming/continuous decode. quantization can amplify that.

ben: short triage plan: 1) re-run conversion with --preserve-specials 2) force num_key_value_heads to HF value in runtime mapping 3) run smoke eval (10 prompts) to confirm decode alignment

maya: running step 1 now. cmd: 
```
rw-convert --src hf/galatea-small --dst redwood/galatea-small --preserve-specials --map-kv-heads=16 --enable-sliding-window
```

ops-bot: Conversion job 9876 started: https://ci.redwood/conv/9876 

evan: if that works, also update model manifest to include explicit chat_template with special token placeholders. we've had models where the default chat template used a different sentinel and that breaks prefix caching.

carla: +1. add quick unit in our conversion tests: assert tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_string([special_token]) == expected and assert kv_heads == config.num_key_value_heads

maya: job finished, quick results: quant smoke shows token positions fixed for 9/10 prompts, one still has intermittent <|pad|> insertion when history length > 2048. looks like max_position_embedding truncation.

ben: ah — we changed max_position_embeddings during conversion to 2048 to save memory. that will reflow positions for longer histories. two options: increase to 4096 or enable circular sliding window + prefix caching.

maya: for now reverted max_position_embeddings to 4096 in converted config and re-ran the failing prompt — fixed. running full eval overnight.

evan: great. follow-up items: - add conversion flag --preserve-max-pos - add regression test for special-token bleed - document mapping rules for rope_scaling and kv heads in onboarding checklist

carla: I'll file the checklist PR and add the unit tests. assigning to @ben for runtime mapping patch.

ben: ack. thanks all :thumbsup:

maya: summary for the ticket: cause = combination of special-token remapping + num_key_value_heads mismatch + reduced max_position_embeddings. mitigation = re-convert with preserve flags, set kv heads to HF value, restore max_pos or enable sliding_window. follow-up = tests + docs.
